description:
Put flutter_martech into ChatUltra. Integration only - proving it works is the verification story.

This is the first time the Flutter bridge meets a real app. Expect it to surface gaps the example app never could.

Blocked by MTSDK-70: there has to be a published package an app team can actually install.

Acceptance criteria:
- ChatUltra depends on a published flutter_martech release and calls configure()
- No 3rd-party SDK (AppsFlyer, Amplitude, RevenueCat, Meta, TikTok, Firebase) is initialised directly by the app
- A debug build can be driven through the MTSDK-10 journey: configure, consent, fire view_screen_splash, make a purchase
- Every friction point is written down as it happens
- Time-to-integrate is recorded and compared against the AI Design iOS and Android baselines

Run the verification suite against the integrated ChatUltra build and get it green.

This is the honest test of the Flutter bridge. A bridge can look correct and still break the RevenueCat to AppsFlyer identity ordering in a way only the suite catches.

Blocked by the integration story, and by MTSDK-71 (the suite running against Flutter at all).

Acceptance criteria:
- All three harnesses run against ChatUltra and pass
- Every discrepancy is triaged: bridge defect, app defect, or wrong harness assumption
- A wrong harness assumption is fixed in the harness, not worked around in the app
- A bridge defect is filed against MTSDK-3, not patched in ChatUltra
- Time from 'integration complete' to 'suite green' is recorded
